'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Matt Carulli DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Carulli]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Username:''' quickdraw345
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
